description_expanded: Top Reasons to book this Lovely Home:* Short Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Access!* Pet Friendly Property (Add'l $200 fee)* Private Saltwater Pool * 4 Bikes Included!* Covered Deck and Patio + Grill* Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Redfish Village* South Side of 30A* Just 2 miles from Gulf Place Town Center to the West and 2 miles from Grayton Beach to the East* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed, 24/7 service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.**Pets are subject to approval. If you are traveling with a pet, please provide the reservations team with the breed of your pet within 24 hours of placing your reservation.*Catch the wind and find Blue Mountain Breeze, a charming 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom home that is the perfect place for your next 30A beach getaway! This rental has a king master bedroom with ensuite bathroom and balcony, king guest room, queen guest room, a bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunk beds, a loft area with a twin-over-twin bunk bed, and a sleeper sofa in the family room, sleeping 14 comfortably. Step outside to the patio and enjoy the private, saltwater pool or cook up something delicious on the propane grill. This beautiful home is nestled in the SandCastles By the Sea community in a quiet cul-de-sac; only a short walk to several local dining spots, sugar white sands, and emerald waters. Blue Mountain Breeze will enthrall you with its charm and beauty, and give you a 30A vacation that will make you want to return here year after year. The Old Blue Mountain Beach Community is located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach. Tucked in between the tranquil Big Redfish Lake and the emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico the Old Blue Mountain Beach community is conveniently located. You’ll be within a couple of blocks of Redfish Village with shops and restaurants, bike and surf rentals and other conveniences. Don’t forget to walk over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for a homemade scoop! Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Explore Redfish Lake, one of the few coastal dune lakes in the world. Come and see for yourself what makes Blue Mountain Beach and the 30A area so special! The Bed Setup:2nd floorGuest Bedroom 3: Queen BedFamily Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa3rd FloorMaster Bedroom: King Bed w/ ensuite bathGuest Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4) Loft Area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedArea Attractions: This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 2 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
